summary: 2 blocking findings apply: constrain progress output to non-stdout/stderr and broaden R4 to all artifact-producing final-regression failures.

items.title: Progress stream can corrupt envelope stdout
items.rationale: flow command stdout is reserved for the JSON envelope, so human progress output must be constrained to stderr or the existing non-stdout human stream.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R1-R4 currently allow stdout or stderr; review cites src/flow/lib/base-command.js outputMode=envelope and src/lib/dispatcher.js stdout envelope behavior.

items.title: Failure artifact output omits existing root-mismatch path
items.rationale: run-final-regression can produce final-regression-result.json and raw log without command discovery or child process when worktree root mismatches, so artifact guidance must cover every artifact-producing failure path.
items.evidence: src/flow/lib/run-final-regression.js root mismatch branch uses FinalRegressionProcessResultFactory.rootMismatch, writes the same resultPath and attemptPath, then returns FINAL_REGRESSION_FAILED.
